description: This file defines the GeminiHandler class, a provider for interacting with Google's Gemini models, including model loading, message creation, prompt completion, and cost calculation.

classes.name: GeminiHandler
classes.description: A class that manages interactions with Google Gemini models, including message streaming, prompt completion, model loading, and cost calculation.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Generates a message stream based on input messages, handling model responses, thoughts, tool calls, grounding, and usage tracking.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the current model configuration, supporting dynamic model loading and selection.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt with the Gemini model, optionally appending grounding citations.

methods.name: getThoughtSignature
methods.description: Returns the last thought signature for continuity.

methods.name: getResponseId
methods.description: Returns the last response ID for conversation tracking.

methods.name: calculateCost
methods.description: Calculates the cost of model usage based on token counts and pricing tiers.

methods.name: extractGroundingSources
methods.description: Extracts grounding source URLs from grounding metadata.

methods.name: extractCitationsOnly
methods.description: Generates citation links from grounding sources.

methods.name: ensureModelsLoaded
methods.description: Ensures Gemini models are loaded, with lazy loading and caching.

methods.name: loadModels
methods.description: Fetches available Gemini models from the API.
